paper.$description: Page background, default node fill. AA-derived light counterpart of the reference site's `--color-ground` (value from the 2026-09-25 app-design review pass, independently WCAG-verified).

paper-2.$description: Container bg, secondary fill — no reference-site equivalent, derived.

surface.$description: Raised above paper — card fill, raised node fill

ink.$description: Primary text, primary stroke. 16.91:1 on paper, 18.26:1 on surface (AAA). AA-derived light counterpart of the reference site's `--color-ink` (2026-09-25 review pass).

muted.$description: Secondary text, default stroke. 5.49:1 on paper, 5.93:1 on surface (AA). AA-derived light counterpart of the reference site's `--color-muted` (2026-09-25 review pass).

soft.$description: Sublabels, boundary labels — no reference-site equivalent, derived.

rule-solid.$description: Stronger borders, baselines. 1.85:1 on paper, 2.00:1 on surface — below WCAG 1.4.11's 3:1 by design (decorative, not interactive), matched to the dark theme's own edge-on-ground band (2.03:1). The reference site's `--color-edge` allowance (2026-09-25 review pass).

accent.$description: GRAPHIC colour only: fills, focus rings, interactive borders. 5.75:1 on paper (AA) — darkened from the dark theme's `#5B6CFF` specifically so it clears AA on a light ground. Never for text below 18px; use `link`. AA-derived light counterpart of the reference site's `--color-signal` (2026-09-25 review pass).

link.$description: The accent TEXT colour, 7.63:1 on paper, 8.24:1 on surface — correct everywhere, no context check needed. AA-derived light counterpart of the reference site's `--color-signal-light` (2026-09-25 review pass).

accent-soft.$description: Tertiary — opt-in third tier, rank/subordinate emphasis.

accent-dark.$description: Signal-tinted surface — the one background that deliberately breaks from `paper`/`surface` (the final CTA band). Same value in light and dark; it is always a dark accent band, not a themed one. The reference site's `--color-signal-dark`.

on-accent.$description: Text/icons on a filled `accent` surface — 8.24:1 on `link`, and clears AA on the graphic `accent` fill at button-label sizes (≥16px, 600 weight). White text on the accent works in the light theme, unlike the dark theme (which must use `paper`-coloured text on its accent) — this asymmetry is real and intentional, not a copy-paste error (2026-09-25 review pass).

on-fill.$description: Fixed white for text on `accent-dark`, the always-dark CTA band that never flips with the theme. Not for themed fills: text on `accent`/`danger` (filled buttons, the checkbox mark) uses `on-accent`, which is ground-coloured in dark.

danger.$description: Destructive or failed state. 6.05:1 on paper (AA) — computed and WCAG-verified against the new paper/surface pair (2026-09-25 review pass).

success.$description: Completed or valid state. 5.00:1 on paper (AA) — computed and WCAG-verified against the new paper/surface pair (2026-09-25 review pass).

warning.$description: Needs attention but not failed. 5.86:1 on paper (AA) — computed and WCAG-verified against the new paper/surface pair (2026-09-25 review pass).

disabled.$description: Inert control text and border. Deliberately low contrast (2.46) — WCAG exempts disabled controls; never use for enabled text.

focus-ring.$description: Focus indicator: 2px ink-on-paper ring, a standard focus-ring recipe. 16.91:1 on paper. Its own token so it can diverge from accent.

scrim.$description: Modal and drawer backdrop, built from ink rather than pure black.
